name: 3D Cylinder Scroll Text
description: A GSAP ScrollTrigger 3D text effect: lines sit around a drum that the scroll turns, rising from below, facing you in the middle and tipping away over the top. Pure CSS 3D, no WebGL.

props.name: lines
props.description: One entry per line on the drum. Keep them short; lines don't wrap.

props.name: step
props.description: Degrees between neighbouring lines. Smaller = a bigger, flatter drum.

props.name: pin
props.description: Hold the drum in the middle of the viewport while it turns.

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element, if the drum sits inside its own scroll container.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the block: font, size, colour. The height is set from the line height.
